title: An Overlap Construction for Relative Linear Extension Ratios
summary: Chan and Pak introduced the relative linear extension ratio $ρ(P,x)=e(P)/e(P-x)$, where $e(P)$ is the number of linear extensions of a finite poset $P$, and let $ν(c,d)$ be the least number of elements of a poset that realizes $ρ(P,x)=d/c$. They proved that $ν(c,d)\le d/c+O(\log d\log\log d)$ for $d\ge 3c$, and asked whether the hypothesis $d\ge 3c$ can be relaxed to $d\ge(1+\varepsilon)c$ or removed.
